title: Xentinel Agent
tagline: Xentinel Agent: Your go-to tool for seamless multisig operations and post-deployment monitoring. Propose, sign, and execute transactions with ease, enhanced by AI assistance, Frame integration, and real-time alerts. Simplify Gnosis Safe management like never before. 🚀
description:
Xentinel Agent

Managing multisig wallets can be complex and time-consuming. Xentinel Agent simplifies the process by providing an intuitive orchestration tool for seamless multisig operations and post-deployment monitoring.

Pain Points Addressed:

	•	Complex Workflow: Coordinating multisig transactions often involves manual steps and delays.
	•	Lack of Visibility: Limited tools for real-time monitoring and transaction lifecycle management.
	•	Inefficient Tools: Traditional interfaces can be cumbersome and unintuitive for managing multisig wallets.

Key Features:

	•	Effortless Multisig Management: Propose, sign, and execute transactions with simple commands.
	•	Real-Time Monitoring: Stay informed with status tracking, signature progress, and execution updates.
	•	Enhanced Transparency: Frame integration delivers rich previews, interactive confirmations, and transaction clarity.
	•	AI Assistance: Smart suggestions, transaction analysis, and context-aware support to streamline workflows.

Xentinel Agent empowers users to efficiently manage their Gnosis Safe wallets, reducing friction and enhancing operational transparency. Whether you’re overseeing a DAO treasury or handling high-value on-chain transactions, Xentinel Agent makes it easy. 🚀
how_its_made:
Xentinel Agent combines advanced technologies to deliver seamless multisig operations and monitoring.

Tech Stack Highlights:

	•	MessageKit + XMTP: Enable an intuitive chat-command interface with secure, decentralized messaging.
	•	Gnosis Safe Protocol Kit: Handles multisig transaction proposals, signatures, and executions.
	•	Frame.js: Powers real-time transaction previews and lifecycle visualization.
	•	Tenderly: Provides pre-execution simulation for secure and predictable transaction outcomes.
	•	Viem: Ensures efficient Ethereum interactions.
	•	Base: Offers fast, low-cost L2 on-chain operations.
	•	Turso: Manages edge-optimized storage for transaction tracking.
	•	OpenAI API: Matches commands intelligently and enhances input recognition.
	•	Curvegrid: Enables webhook triggers for automated transaction updates and workflow integrations.
	•	ENS: Supports human-readable addresses, simplifying identity management, particularly useful for XMTP-based messaging in Web3 environments.
